name: Latitude Interest Free Gateway for WooCommerce
author: Latitude Financial Services

sections.description: This plugin provides a simple and secure integration between WooCommerce and Latitude Checkout API Service. Merchant Partners can start offering Latitude Interest Free (AU) or Gem Interest Free (NZ) on Checkout for Customers to select. The Customer’s payment journey will leverage Latitude’s PCI-compliant hosted payment page.
sections.installation:
This section outlines the steps to install the Latitude Interest Free plugin.

  1. Search for plugin with name “latitude interest free”.
  2. Install and Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go WooCommerce Settings –> Payment Gateways and configure your Latitude Interest Free plugin.
